sources.title: MELD-Based Conversational Sentiment Dataset | IEEE DataPort
sources.snippet: The MELD-Based Conversational Sentiment Dataset is a multimodal dataset designed for conversational sentiment and emotion analysis. It incorporates textual, audio, and visual modalities to capture diverse emotional cues from multi-party conversations.
